steps.title: Prepare tuberacks and load samples
steps.instruction: Refill the tuberacks for the number of samples specified and load samples 1‑24 into the tuberack positioned on slot 1.

steps.title: Transfer supernatant
steps.instruction: Transfer 900 µL of supernatant from each sample to a new Eppendorf tube, taking care not to disturb the pellet.

steps.title: Dry extracts
steps.instruction: Dry all transferred samples using a nitrogen dryer or a SpeedVac, applying no heat (no temperature setting).

steps.title: Reconstitute with mobile phase A
steps.instruction: Reconstitute each dried extract by adding 100 µL of mobile phase A.
